EnumProperty.Name: KNSoftQuicIntegration
EnumProperty.Description: Select how KNSoft.Quic is added to this configuration.

EnumValue.Name: None
EnumValue.Description: Do not add KNSoft.Quic headers, libraries, or runtime files.

EnumValue.Name: Manual
EnumValue.Description: Add the header and library search paths without selecting a library.

EnumValue.Name: DynamicMT
EnumValue.Description: Link the import library and copy the /MT KNSoft.Quic DLL to the output directory.

EnumValue.Name: DynamicMD
EnumValue.Description: Link the import library and copy the /MD KNSoft.Quic DLL to the output directory.

EnumValue.Name: StaticLTCG
EnumValue.Description: Link the toolset-specific LTCG static library without changing the caller's PGO settings.

EnumValue.Name: StaticLTCGPGO
EnumValue.Description: Link the toolset-specific LTCG static library and use the bundled read-only PGO profile unless the caller explicitly configures linker PGO.
